reason: 该插件的核心用户可见用途是把 DeepSeek Harness 运行中的组件活动可视化为实时面板（`/evo`）并通过 SSE 进行事件推送，属于前端可视化监控类能力，基于仓库 README 和 package 信息可直接确认，不属于代码生成或文档处理类插件。

summaries.zh: dsh-evo-vis 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 宿主侧插件，在 Web UI 中实时展示会话、模型与工具等组件活动，并以可视化面板方式呈现事件与状态。
summaries.en: dsh-evo-vis is a host-side DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows session, model, and tool activity in the Web UI as a real-time visualization panel.

capabilities: Registers Web UI routes for a full-screen panel, snapshot data endpoint, and SSE stream in the host web profile.
Listens to DeepSeek Harness Cordis events and normalizes them into real-time UI activity metrics.
Injects a floating entry point in the Web UI via tapIndex and supports runtime configuration via patch file.

reasons.code: README states the plugin provides `/evo` (UI), `/evo/data` (snapshot), and `/evo/stream` (SSE) for real-time visualization and replay.
README describes listening to `session/event`, `tools/result`, `agent/*`, and related events to map component activity into energy/level-based visuals and stats.
Package metadata defines the plugin as a dsh bundle patch (`dsh.bundle.patch`), confirming it runs as a host-side integration through DeepSeek Harness configuration.
